subject: Resume and close the real New Westside parent goal through Storybook build, visual verification, and product promotion

verified_capabilities: multi-loop control plane v1 bounded acceptance
Storybook three-candidate promotion v1 bounded acceptance
autonomous learning activation and single-owner queue
Newsroom control plane and real-signal loop
context.known_boundary: The three promoted outputs are still candidates. Capability acceptance is not product acceptance and must not be reported as New Westside completion.

objective: Use the already-built Doré capabilities on the actual New Westside product surface. Continue the preserved parent goal without restarting research from zero. Take the promoted Storybook candidates into a real product build, collect browser/visual/responsive/accessibility evidence on the actual surface, compare against the locked production baseline and Westside visual invariants, select/promote only an evidence-backed winner or explicitly return FAIL/LEARNING if none qualifies, then persist canonical product acceptance evidence.
required_sequence: reconcile current New Westside parent-goal state and reuse existing knowledge/evidence
finish any remaining reference expansion only if it materially blocks product judgment; do not treat 40 references as a substitute for product evidence
materialize the three promoted candidates on the real New Westside homepage/product surface without mutating the locked baseline prematurely
run deterministic build and real-browser verification across stable desktop/mobile viewports
collect render, function, accessibility, responsive, visual-stability, asset, and product-invariant evidence
perform explicit Westside visual judgment comparing the real product candidates and baseline
promote exactly one qualifying product state only if evidence supports it; if no candidate qualifies, preserve parent goal and enter LEARNING/REPAIR rather than false PASS
after promotion, rerun product monitor and verify no Journal/site boundary or cover-wall regression
persist canonical receipt and memory/register reconciliation distinguishing capability acceptance from product acceptance

pass_requires: real New Westside product build succeeds
real-browser visual evidence exists for desktop and mobile
locked baseline immutability is demonstrated until explicit promotion
winner has explicit WESTSIDE_FIT judgment backed by evidence
canonical receipt identifies exact promoted product state and commit/evidence lineage

loop_contract.on_stall: diagnose -> smallest informative repair -> resume same parent goal
loop_contract.on_failure: preserve parent goal; produce information gain; do not blind retry
loop_contract.on_learning_gap: activate durable learning safely under single-owner semantics, then resume
loop_contract.on_pass: only emit PASS when acceptance_contract.pass_requires are all evidenced
